title: 2026 UK ETS SAF lifecycle assessment versus zero-rating QA

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of SAF consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel

facts.source_fact: Eligible SAF is currently zero rated under the UK ETS.
Zero rating means allowances are not surrendered for the combustion emissions attributed to eligible SAF.
The consultation notes that real SAF does not achieve 100% lifecycle emissions reductions.
A lifecycle approach would recognise SAF in proportion to actual lifecycle emissions savings versus fossil kerosene.
A lifecycle approach would allow higher-saving SAF to reduce surrender obligations more than lower-saving SAF.
The consultation says lifecycle treatment would align more closely with the polluter-pays principle.
A lifecycle approach would require evidence of SAF lifecycle emissions savings.
The Authority would need to consider acceptable methodologies for lifecycle calculations.
The consultation notes lifecycle treatment would likely require METS changes and greater administration.
Lifecycle assessment is a consultation option; current UK ETS treatment remains zero rating.
